description: Symbols the documentation deliberately references before they exist. Every entry needs a reason and the thing that will make it removable — an allowlist without an expiry condition is just a way to stop looking. check_doc_examples.py reports an entry as STALE once the symbol resolves, so a landed feature surfaces its own cleanup rather than leaving a permanent exemption behind.

allow.reason: The `#[derive(BindingSchema)]` macro from the apcore-macros crate. Rust auto-schema inference is unimplemented — §12's support matrix marks `auto_schema: true` / `permissive` as not implemented and `strict` as partial for Rust, and resolve_schemas() warns on every permissive fallback. The example documents the intended surface.
allow.removable_when: apcore-macros lands (F11) and the crate root re-exports BindingSchema

allow.reason: An error variant proposed by the `include:` cross-file config composition RFC (D-65). RFCs describe surfaces that do not exist yet — that is what makes them RFCs.
allow.removable_when: the include: RFC is accepted and ErrorCode gains the variant
